editorial:
The Monster Walks is a 60-minute old-dark-house chiller released on February 7, 1932. Frank R. Strayer directed it for Action Pictures, and Mayfair Pictures distributed it. Rex Lease and Vera Reynolds star, with Mischa Auer and Martha Mattox in support. Robert Ellis is credited as writer. Ruth Earlton arrives at her inherited estate, where a hairy hand threatens her at night and an experimental ape is involved.

The rights question is the renewal. For a film published in February 1932, the renewal window was the 28th year of the first term, about Feb 1959 to Feb 1960. The 1959 and 1960 CCE renewal volumes are the primary searches, and the 1961 volume is only a check for a late filing. I searched the 1960 renewal sections by title only and saw no entry for the film. I did not search under the proprietor names or variant spellings, and I did not read the 1959 volume in full. The search is not finished, so the print is left undetermined. The music and story layers were not checked and stay undetermined. The Internet Archive also hosts a colorized, upscaled version, uploaded July 20, 2022 and described as made with AI tools. That added material may be protected even if the original black-and-white print is free.
